subject: Kraken XRP/USD ticker observation with bounded retrieval interval and explicit quote/last-trade asynchrony

mission.foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

capture.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact JSON text exposed by the web retrieval result; not a byte-exact original HTTP response or header capture.
capture.note: The API response was inspected after automation start and before the subsequent time check. The exact request timestamp and provider event timestamp were not exposed. The cutoff uses the latest known retrieval bound and is not an exchange event-time cutoff.

limitations: Single exchange only; not consolidated market price or liquidity.
Ticker response does not expose a provider event timestamp.
Last trade, best bid/ask and rolling aggregates are not guaranteed to share one event time.
Top-of-book only; displayed sizes are not full depth or guaranteed executable liquidity.
Rendered-response hash is not a byte-exact raw HTTP receipt.

quote_component_quality.interpretation: The last-trade field is below the displayed best bid in this response. This is retained as a component-asynchrony warning; it is not repaired or treated as an executable cross.

limitations: Kraken top-of-book is not consolidated depth.
The 24-hour VWAP and volume are venue-specific aggregates.
The UTC-day open begins at midnight UTC and is not a rolling 24-hour open.
No return is calculated against earlier snapshots because exact provider event times are absent.
The very narrow displayed spread does not establish depth, resilience or executable size.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: XRP remains materially below the venue's rolling 24-hour VWAP during the observation.
support: Last trade is approximately 3.98% below Kraken's rolling 24-hour VWAP.
disconfirming_or_missing: A single venue snapshot does not establish market-wide selling pressure.
The provider event time is missing.
No synchronized trade/book sequence or cross-venue comparison is present.
tests: Capture exchange-native trades and depth with provider timestamps and sequence IDs.
Compare synchronized spot prices across independent venues.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: The displayed top-of-book may be tighter or higher than the last-trade field.
support: Best bid and ask are $1.20295 and $1.20296, while last trade is $1.20282.
disconfirming_or_missing: Ticker components may be sampled asynchronously.
One displayed level does not show available depth or order persistence.
tests: Capture WebSocket book/trade streams with sequence continuity.
Measure depth within 10, 25 and 50 basis points and cancellation rates.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: Apparent changes between recent snapshots may be dominated by unknown sampling times rather than a valid short-horizon return.
support: The API exposes no provider event timestamp and this response has no exact retrieval timestamp.
disconfirming_or_missing: A future exchange-native event-time capture could establish a synchronized comparison.
tests: Preserve raw response bytes and headers at collection time.
Use exchange event timestamps and monotonic sequence IDs.

reasons: No exact retrieval timestamp; only a bounded retrieval interval is known.
No byte-exact raw HTTP body or response-header receipt.
Single-venue ticker with asynchronous quote/trade components.
No consolidated multi-level order-book or synchronized cross-venue data.

forecast.reason: A single asynchronous venue ticker is insufficient for a directional forecast or point-in-time feature admission.

next_actions: Add timestamped exchange-native trade and multi-level order-book capture with sequence validation.
Reconcile Kraken with at least two independent spot venues at a common cutoff.
Retain original HTTP bytes, response headers, retrieval timestamp and SHA-256 receipt at collection time.
Keep this observation research-only; do not use it in walk-forward features or forecast issuance.
